instruction: Compare iPhone 15 Pro Max with iPhone 14 Pro on Apple's comparison page

metadata.explanation: Task requires comparing two iPhone Pro models (Max vs regular Pro). Agent needs to navigate to Apple Compare page and select iPhone 15 Pro Max and iPhone 14 Pro. The evaluator parses the URL query parameter 'modelList' and verifies it contains the two specified models in any order.
metadata.verification: Similar task to original - comparing 2 iPhone models mixing Pro Max and Pro. Uses identical evaluator structure with different model names.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses active_tab_url_parse to extract the modelList query parameter from Apple comparison page URL
Metric check_direct_json_object appropriately compares the extracted model list with expected values
Using ignore_list_order=true is semantically correct since comparing A vs B is equivalent to B vs A
Expected values (iphone-15-pro-max, iphone-14-pro) are accurate and match Apple URL format
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies both required iPhone models are present in comparison
Data flow is correct: active tab URL → parse query params → extract modelList → split by comma → compare with expected
Getter will correctly return None if required parameter is missing, causing evaluation to fail appropriately
No type mismatches or logical errors in the evaluation chain
